image_description: A landscape photograph featuring three bison in a dry, grassy field. One bison is prominent in the foreground left, facing forward with visible horns and head. Another bison is in the foreground right, grazing with its head down, showing its hump and hindquarters. A third bison is visible in the mid-ground left, walking laterally. The background shows distant hills and sparse vegetation under a bright sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The foreground left bison clearly displays a large, broad head with characteristic short, curved horns. The morphology matches the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible on the foreground left bison; there is distinct shaggy hair hanging from the chin/throat area.
The eye of the foreground left bison is visible and appears dark, consistent with the checkpoint.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick fur of the head, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible bison exhibit the characteristic massive build and high withers/shoulder hump typical of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is visibly shaggy and dark brown, particularly dense around the shoulders and head, forming the iconic hump.
Comparing the foreground right bison's rear to its front, the fur on the hindquarters appears shorter and less dense than the shaggy forequarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are proportionally small relative to the massive bulk of the animal's head and body.
The legs of all bison are obscured by the tall, dry grass. Hooves are completely invisible. Cannot verify structural correctness of feet.
The tail of the mid-ground bison is visible and appears short with a darker, bushy end. The foreground right bison's tail is partially visible and consistent.

artifact_observations.location: Foreground grass and bison fur interface
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight 'painterly' or smudged texture in the grass immediately surrounding the foreground bison's chest. The boundary between the fur and the grass is slightly soft, lacking crisp occlusion edges, suggesting minor generation blur or fusion.

The legs of the bison in the middle distance appear to merge into the grass without clear definition. While partly due to distance/resolution, the lack of any discernible leg structure (just a dark blob) is a common AI artifact where complex limb structures fail in cluttered environments.
